title: calceolaria flexuosa subsp. chrysocalyx
intro: Calceolaria flexuosa subsp. chrysocalyx, commonly known as the "creeper slipper flower" or "yellow slipper flower", is a flowering plant species native to the Andes mountain range. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Calceolaria flexuosa subsp. chrysocalyx include its ability to lower fever, soothe coughs, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various respiratory and inflammatory conditions. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
